_comment: WP-O1 output (H-O6): app roster for the Central Orchestrator. Adding a 6th app = add one entry here + author its wrapper skill; no orchestrator code changes.

brain.description: General-purpose multi-agent orchestrator (research, code, data analysis, app building, content, planning)
brain.reason: No bare top-level name collision when it is the only app imported in-process alongside feynman_agent

feynman_agent.description: Feynman-technique Q&A tutor over an ingested knowledge base
feynman_agent.reason: Only app whose bare top-level module name (agent, singular) does not collide with brain's internal agents/ or tools/ packages

stock_agent.description: 7-agent financial analysis pipeline (fundamentals, technicals, risk, sentiment, algo signals) for a stock ticker
stock_agent.reason: Owns agents/ and tools/ packages that collide with brain's bare top-level import names (ModuleNotFoundError confirmed empirically, order-dependent) -- HTTP avoids importing it into the shared process at all

health_agent.description: Health vitals extraction + threshold/trend analysis from screenshots, PDFs, DOCX, or manual input
health_agent.reason: Owns agents/ and tools/ packages colliding with brain's bare top-level names -- same fix as stock_agent

vedic_astro.description: Vedic astrology chart calculation (D-1/D-9 etc.) + 6-agent deep prediction reading for a birth place/time
vedic_astro.reason: Owns an agents/ package colliding with brain's bare top-level name; also the only app needing the 2-step geocode->reading glue, kept inside its one wrapper skill's driver (H-O4)
